recipes.name: Flanders' Hot Chocolate inspired by The Simpsons Movie
ingredients: 1/4 cup sweetened condensed milk (optional for ultra creamy hot chocolate)
instructions: Add whole milk, heavy cream, and evaporated milk to a saucepan. (If using sweetened condensed milk, whisk it into the mixture.) - 2 cups whole milk - 1 cup heavy cream - 1 cup evaporated milk
Place the saucepan over medium heat and whisk continuously while heating.
Heat until steaming hot, but not boiling. Around 190°F.
Add the Ghirardelli cocoa powder to the hot milk mixture and whisk until smooth. - ½ cup of Ghirardelli cocoa powder
Stir in the chopped 70% dark baking chocolate and continue whisking until fully melted and incorporated. - ½ cup of 70% dark baking chocolate
Add the sugar, salt, and a small pinch of ground cinnamon. Whisk to combine. - ½ cup of sugar - pinch of salt - pinch of ground cinnamon
If desired, stir in the instant coffee for added depth of flavor. - 1 tsp of instant coffee optional
Pour the hot chocolate into a heatproof mug or serving cup.
Top with a generous dollop of whipped cream. - whipped cream
Sprinkle chocolate shavings over the whipped cream. - chocolate shavings
Place a small graham cracker on top of the whipped cream and add an additional layer of whipped cream to secure it. - 1 small graham cracker - whipped cream
Stick a marshmallow on top of the graham cracker and toast it to your liking using a kitchen torch. - 1 marshmallow - 1 small graham cracker
